description: If \(f:A\to B\) is constant on the classes of an equivalence relation, then its induced map \(\bar f:A/{\sim}\to B\) has the same range as \(f\).
signature:
Set.range_quotient_lift.{u_1, u_4} {α : Type u_1} {ι : Sort u_4} {f : ι → α} [s : Setoid ι]
  (hf : ∀ (a b : ι), a ≈ b → f a = f b) : Set.range (Quotient.lift f hf) = Set.range f
